browser-use/jev-ultrafast.readme_summary: **A browser agent with a dynamic, indexed action space.**
readme_features: One request per decision cycle. Operation and target heads share the same observed state.
No screenshots in the default agent loop. Jev consumes structured state. The inspector opts into screenshots; the video uses a separate continuous screencast.
One browser call per snapshot. Read visible controls, their names, values, and text atomically. Keep references to the actual DOM nodes.

Validate the selected target. Clicks check the document, form values, target, and nearby context. Animation alone does not force another prediction. Resolve current geometry and reject covered controls before input.

Wait for useful state. After typing into a combobox, wait for visible suggestions, capped at 200 ms. Other interactions get at most two animation frames or 50 ms. These reads happen after execution is logged.

jaredpalmer/kev.description: Jev-like family of decision models built on top of Qwen3.5/3.8 you can train and run on your own
jaredpalmer/kev.readme_summary: Small Jev-like decision models you can train and run yourself.
readme_features: Yes/no (noul), multiple-choice (choice) and rating (score) questions in one request. The questions share the text but can't read each other.
Calibrated probabilities by default: each checkpoint ships with a fitted temperature.
Drop-in for Jev: the TypeSafe Python SDK works against a Kev server unchanged.
Four sizes, versioned together as Kev 1.0: from a 0.8B that runs on a laptop to a 27B for a single data-centre GPU.
Documents of up to 65,536 tokens, on CUDA and on Apple Silicon through MLX. Each model card says how long a document can get before accuracy drops.

analysis.positioning: Kev 是基于 Qwen3.5/3.8 构建的 Jev 类决策模型家族，支持本地训练与运行。它解决用户自主掌控决策模型的需求，特点是在单次请求中混合是非、多选和评分问题，默认提供校准概率，且兼容 Jev 的 TypeSafe Python SDK。
target_users: 需要在本地或自有基础设施上运行决策模型的开发者与团队，适用于是非、多选和评分等自动化决策场景。
需要处理长文档并关注概率校准的应用场景，可能涉及文档分析与内容评估。
core_capabilities: 支持在单次请求中混合是非、多选和评分问题，问题间共享文本但互不可见，提升多维度决策效率。
默认提供校准概率，每个检查点附带拟合温度，增强输出结果的可靠性。
支持长达 65,536 tokens 的文档处理，覆盖 CUDA 与 Apple Silicon 平台。
technical_analysis: 项目使用 Python 开发，采用 Apache-2.0 许可证，技术生态围绕 Qwen3 展开。
支持通过 CUDA 和 Apple Silicon 的 MLX 运行，提供从 0.8B 到 27B 四种规模的模型，适应从笔记本到单卡数据中心 GPU 的部署需求。
集成形态表现为可作为 Jev 的直接替代，现有 TypeSafe Python SDK 无需更改即可对接 Kev 服务器。
why_it_matters: 项目提供本地化训练与运行能力，结合默认校准概率与长文档支持，对需要自主掌控决策模型的开发者具有较高实用价值。
从现有信息看，项目在创建后短期内获得较多关注且发布了 1.0 版本，显示出一定的社区活跃度。
limitations: 不同模型在处理超长文档时的精度下降阈值需参考具体模型卡，本次输入未提供，需进一步核实。
快速入门指南内容为空，本次输入未提供，需进一步核实具体的部署与运行步骤。
opportunities: 机会假设：可以开发针对特定业务场景的模型微调工具，优化决策准确率。
机会假设：可以构建可视化运维面板，监控多规模模型的运行状态与校准概率输出。
